tips.title: Track Your Expenses
tips.tip: Write down or record your daily expenses so you know where your money is going.

tips.title: Create a Monthly Budget
tips.tip: Plan your expected income and expenses before starting each month.

tips.title: Separate Needs and Wants
tips.tip: Before buying something, ask yourself whether it is a need or simply a want.

tips.title: Set a Savings Goal
tips.tip: Choose a specific savings target and decide how much you can contribute every month.

tips.title: Save Before Spending
tips.tip: Set aside your planned savings amount before spending money on optional purchases.

tips.title: Avoid Impulse Buying
tips.tip: Wait before making an unplanned purchase and decide whether you really need it.

tips.title: Watch Small Expenses
tips.tip: Small daily purchases can add up over time, so include them in your budget.

tips.title: Review Subscriptions
tips.tip: Check your subscriptions regularly and identify services that you no longer use.

tips.title: Plan Before Shopping
tips.tip: Make a shopping list and try to avoid unnecessary purchases.

tips.title: Keep an Emergency Fund
tips.tip: Set aside some money for unexpected expenses whenever possible.

tips.title: Review Your Budget
tips.tip: Review your spending regularly and adjust your budget when your circumstances change.

tips.title: Compare Before Buying
tips.tip: Compare available options before making a purchase so you can make a planned decision.
